meta.objective: Portfolio impact / risk (objective #1) — flag branches whose borrower base is concentrated in a STRESSED sector.
meta.label: ESTIMATED COMPOSITE — MEASURED occupation shares (Overture Maps Places, a sample/lower bound) weighted by an ESTIMATED 'stressed sector' judgement. A triage flag, NOT a measured default rate.
meta.measured: occupation shares per branch (share of ≤10km establishments in each Overture bucket) — from branch_occupations.json.
meta.estimated: the stress weighting: factory borrower-base stress is a fixed national macro lever (Thai manufacturing softness); agriculture borrower-base stress is the branch's province crop-household stress (crop_stress.json agri_stress, itself an estimated composite).

stress_weights_note.factory: FIXED national level (0.50) — ESTIMATED macro slowdown lever, same for every branch.
stress_weights_note.agriculture: PER-PROVINCE — the branch's crop_stress.json agri_stress (0..1), ESTIMATED; 0 where the province has no crop_stress entry.
stress_weights_note.all_other_buckets: weight 0 — not flagged (we only weight sectors we can defend as stressed).

meta.formula: occ_risk = 100 * sum_k share_k * stress_weight_k  (k in {factory, agriculture}); flag = occ_risk >= p95(nonzero occ_risk) AND total_estab >= 20.
meta.flag_threshold_rule: p95 (nearest-rank) of the NONZERO score distribution, resolved deterministically from the data at build time — a fixed absolute cutoff sat above the achievable score ceiling and flagged nothing. null when the distribution is degenerate (no nonzero scores).
meta.source_occupations: Overture Maps Places — measured establishment points (a sample/lower bound, not a registry)
meta.index_note: branches[] is INDEX-ALIGNED to platform/data/branches.json (entry i <-> branch i), identical to branch_occupations.json.

fields.s: ESTIMATED occupation-stress score 0..100 (measured shares x estimated weights).
fields.f: flag — true when s >= flag_threshold (the resolved p95 of the nonzero score distribution) AND total establishments >= min_estab.
fields.d: MEASURED dominant occupation bucket key for the branch's ≤10km catchment (or null).
fields.t: MEASURED total establishments ≤10km (the denominator; 0 = empty/unknown catchment).
